query:
MATCH (n)
                WHERE toLower(n.name) CONTAINS toLower('DiagnosticReport') AND toLower(n.consumer_id) CONTAINS toLower('Milton509_Ortiz186_d66b5418-06cb-fc8a-8c13-85685b6ac939')
            WITH n
            CALL {
                WITH n
                MATCH (n)<-[r]->(neighbor)
                WHERE NOT type(r) IN ['subject', 'patient'] AND NOT neighbor:Date
                RETURN collect({neighbor_text: neighbor.text, relationship: type(r)}) AS neighbors
            }
           RETURN "{'Main health record': '" + n.text + "', 'Related health records': [" + 
                reduce(s = "", neighbor IN neighbors | s + "('Relationship' :'" + neighbor.relationship + "', 'Health Record' :'" + neighbor.neighbor_text + "'), ") + "]}
" AS text
